info.title: MyScoutee administrative-access
info.description: Typed calls to the existing AdministrativeAccess owner. Native validation, queries, state transitions and scheduler behavior retained. REAL/DEMO and explicit job scope; no-store. 2 MiB request / 8 MiB response bounds; no automatic retries.
